title: Complete the teaching redesign: lesson architecture, narration, camera direction
statusReason: The three gaps that made Step 14 CONDITIONAL are closed: the lesson is the nine-chapter teaching arc the brief describes, every new instructional line is narrated, and chapter-level camera direction is authored and tested.
